explanation: Walk to the selected 1-based node position. Link the new node to its successor, then link the selected node to the new node. The existing head and all existing nodes are retained.
timeComplexity: O(p) time to reach position p.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space and one new node.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract.
correctness: Before insertion, selected points to the requested 1-based node. Saving its successor in newNode.Next and then setting selected.Next=newNode adds exactly one node between them while leaving the remainder reachable and preserving the original head.
walkthrough: For [7,4,9], position 2 selects value 4. Give the new node 6 a successor of 9, then change 4.next to that new node. Return the same head, now traversing [7,4,6,9].
edgeCases: Position 1 means insert after the head, not before it.
Inserting after the last node appends a new tail.
Existing nodes and their values are retained.
